newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's cuts Pioneer long-term debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts Pioneer long-term debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had cut Pioneer Electronic Corp's long-term debt rating to Baa3 from Baa2.
Moody's said in a statement that it had also lowered short-term debt ratings on two Pioneer affiliates, Pioneer Financial Management Inc and Pioneer Electronic B.V., to Prime-3 from Prime-2.

The downgrade reflects Moody's expectations that Pioneer's recent poor operating performance, due to its weakening market position and difficult operating environment, will result in reduced cash flow and lower debt protection measures over the intermediate term, the rating agency said.
Pioneer's series of restructuring efforts, including drastic job cuts, may not be enough to buoy its business if it fails to come up with some promising new products in a swift manner, Moody's said.
